title: Reserve banked cloze
instructions: Choose one word from the shared bank for each gap. Three words will not be used.

parts.prompt: Costume library gap 1: choose the word that best completes the full passage.

choice_rationales.A: Crowded explains why movement was difficult.
choice_rationales.C: Labelled does not describe lack of space.
choice_rationales.D: Damage would not necessarily block access.
choice_rationales.F: Regular does not fit the consequence.
choice_rationales.G: An adverb cannot complete this construction.
choice_rationales.H: Measured does not describe the room.

parts.hint: Protected reserve: no hint is available.
parts.correct_explanation: “Crowded” matches a room filled with disordered boxes.

parts.prompt: Costume library gap 2: choose the word that best completes the full passage.

choice_rationales.A: Crowded is not a reporting verb.
choice_rationales.C: Labelled does not introduce an idea.
choice_rationales.D: Damaged conflicts with the intended action.
choice_rationales.G: Silently cannot be the main verb.
choice_rationales.H: Measured does not fit the gerund phrase.

parts.hint: Protected reserve: no hint is available.
parts.correct_explanation: “Suggested” introduces the idea of creating a library.

parts.prompt: Costume library gap 3: choose the word that best completes the full passage.

choice_rationales.A: Crowded cannot be the past-tense action here.
choice_rationales.B: The team is organising, not proposing, each box.
choice_rationales.C: Labelled fits identifying boxes by categories.
choice_rationales.H: Measuring is not the stated organisation method.

parts.hint: Protected reserve: no hint is available.
parts.correct_explanation: “Labelled” fits marking boxes by size and period.

parts.prompt: Costume library gap 4: choose the word that best completes the full passage.

choice_rationales.A: A hat cannot be crowded in this context.
choice_rationales.C: Already labelled hats would not require repair.

parts.hint: Protected reserve: no hint is available.
parts.correct_explanation: “Damaged” explains why the hats needed repair.

parts.prompt: Costume library gap 5: choose the word that best completes the full passage.

choice_rationales.A: Crowded does not describe their emotion.
choice_rationales.C: Labelled is not an emotional response.
choice_rationales.D: Damaged does not fit the people.

parts.hint: Protected reserve: no hint is available.
parts.correct_explanation: “Grateful” describes the actors' appreciation when the jacket was found.
